seeds.content: [US Executive Branch · Executive Order 2027-04 · issued 2027-01-15 · effective 2027-02-15] Training runs above 10^26 FLOP now need a federal licence.

posts.content: [US Executive Branch · Executive Order 2027-04 · issued 2027-01-15 · effective 2027-02-15] Training runs above 10^26 FLOP now need a federal licence.
The US Executive Branch has ordered licences for the largest runs. Labs say they are reviewing it.

interviews.reason: The committee will hold labs to the order.
We need time to file without halting work.
Someone has to check these systems.
